notes.title: Sigh of the Abyss is available NOW!
notes.notes:
After three years of development, [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] is ready to leave my screen and appear on yours.

The game is dark yet tender, cruel, hopeful—just like life, it has its moments of levity, of despair, of resilience. I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/

[b]What about [i]Shadow Bonds[/i]?[/b]
[i]Shadow Bonds[/i] is now [u]non-canonical[/u], but it's still a good introduction to the setting & characters. 
It will stay available as a free game!

Thank you for all your support. See you in Carolise!
-Rascal

notes.title: NEW voiced demo ✨
notes.notes:
Surprise! [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] joins the Steam Next Fest with a [b]voiced demo[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/ef26b0c93b6127f67892faaa45de106e0b223e47.png[/img]
The [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is an event centered around upcoming games and their demos. 
It's a treasure trove of incredible gems, and every year I have a blast discovering new games to look forward to ✨ I'm really excited to join this year—it's my first Next Fest as a developer!

You can download the demo from the main page of [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i]:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/

[h2]The demo[/h2]
The demo is meant to be concise & accessible to players who are not acquainted with the cast.
It features a ton of voice acting—around 70% is voiced!
Ascanio makes his first official appearance in there. He's the only love interest not featured in [i]Shadow Bonds[/i], and I wanted everyone to meet him, especially because he became a love interest thanks to the support of the Kickstarter backers.

The demo is somewhat representative of the full game, but it's also... not. 
[h3]Character creation has been simplified.[/h3]
You can customize the name of the Envoy and determine her personality in the demo, but her powers have been pre-determined since they are only featured in [u]one[/u] minor choice. 
This will not be the case in the full game—she will be fully customizable there, and her powers will have more impact!
[h3]Choices, branches and lines had to be cut to streamline the experience. [/h3]
This is the direct result of the new context behind some scenes! 
A major choice has also been cut. In the full game, [spoiler]infiltrating the Halls[/spoiler] is not mandatory! You can also heed Sylas' pleas, let the matter rest & find a subtler way to find out what happened. This slow-burn approach spans multiple days and is not voiced, so it was cut from the demo.
When you play the full game, events [b]will play differently[/b]!
[h3]Three romance options are available in the demo.[/h3]
You'll be able to enjoy the company of Sylas, Alpheon and Malec. Their scenes have been taken from early in the game, before committing yourself to your beloved, and feature variations based on your romantic preferences ✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/e4c0fed1a4e3e8fb13cbc8e5a972cba1d43df654.gif[/img]
[h2]What does it mean for Shadow Bonds?[/h2]
A lot has changed between the first draft and the final script of the game, so [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] is now [b]non-canonical[/b]. You can call it a side story / what-if of [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i]!

I hope you will enjoy the demo! I would love to know what you think ːcharmwitchː
I have created a new section in the forums to collect feedback—you can find it in the game's main hub.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/

Have a lovely day! ✨

notes.title: August small update!
The Steam page of Sigh of the Abyss is live!
notes.notes:
[i]Shadow Bonds[/i] is a bit of an atypical prologue. It presents a side-story that touches on the various bonds the protagonist can have with the other characters, but... how did she reach that point?
Was she born with those powers? How did she become close with Sylas, Marané, Alpheon and Malec?

All these questions (and more) will be revealed in [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i].
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/
Yes, funding has been secured and the full game will happen!
Spanning over ten chapters rippling with choices and consequences, [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] is a dark fantasy tale written in blood and shadows.

[i]You are the product of a bloody ritual; human in appearance, yet imbued with monstrous powers.
The men and women that sacrificed their life for yours speak to you in whispers, beg you to put their spirits to rest.
Will you acquiesce to them or will you defy them?[/i]

notes.title: Who will you be?
notes.notes:
Greetings, envoys!
[i]Shadow Bonds[/i] will release in 6 days. We're [i]really[/i] excited about it and can't wait to have you play the game! In the meanwhile, we're keeping up with our weekly devlogs. Today's post is all about you, the protagonist!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/47ead48bee0dcc1a03223b3021a51ca968d41f58.png[/img]
The protagonist has a fixed appearance, but you can customize her in several ways:
[h3]Who are you?[/h3]
She does not have a set name, so you can pick whichever one you like!
We know first-hand that it's hard to come up with a name out of the blue, that's why we included a list of lore-friendly pre-generated names. Click on the button next to the name field to cycle through them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/3d1fbdda829de3be9bcc371ae874378b3ddb47cf.gif[/img]
[h3]How did the Abyss bless you?[/h3]
There are three main powers in [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i]:
[list]
[*] [i]Physical prowess[/i] determines how strong your punches are, how fast your reflexes are, and how much damage you can endure;
[*] [i]Shadow magic[/i] allows you to commune with shadows and have them do your bidding;
[*] [i]Mind control[/i] lets you bend the will of others within certain limits;
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/722618160ed635ef8e87d5e0ac29f1cb143c8781.gif[/img]
You'll be able to allocate seven points at the start of the game!
[h3]What makes you tick?[/h3]
The four humors of Hippocratic medicine color the tone of your answers and let the protagonist embrace her emotions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/f47bd13ca338356866c6200938b9d1c335f0995d.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]Sanguine [/i]answers are usually happy and carefree;
[*] [i]Phlegmatic [/i]responses are thoughtful, but tend towards inaction;
[*] [i]Melancholic [/i]answers are driven by fear;
[*] [i]Choleric [/i]responses are curt and sarcastic;[/list]
As the decisions you make shape the dominant personality of the main character, she will behave accordingly in certain scenes!
[h3]Who do you like?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/1b9a4b2320816067fd8b665f2dffbaaf7c860eb9.gif[/img]
You'll also be able to determine the protagonist's romantic preference, and you can change those at any time during play!

[i]Sigh of the Abyss: Shadow Bonds[/i] releases on April 5! Join us next week for more about the game. 
You can also check out the shiny new  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TdRPJRV6CJM]voiced trailer[/url]!

notes.title: More about the romances in Shadow Bonds!
notes.notes:
Greetings, envoys!
We'll be posting something every week leading up to the release of [i]Shadow Bonds[/i]. 
Today we want to introduce you to the romance system of the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/ac7770b3a27dd65c85f256398fa2e6653fd5111a.gif[/img]
[h3]A taste of the full game[/h3]
Despite being an introduction to the characters and setting of [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i], [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] is a side-story that can be enjoyed on its own. Because of that, the characters you'll meet already have a relationship with the protagonist—so you skip the guarded 'getting to know each other' phase to experience a bond already formed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/443b12d29a137f4b735938920009d2ac414bca6e.gif[/img]
[h3]Romance your way[/h3]
At the start of the game you can pick the romantic preferences of your protagonist: you can select an interest in men, women, both or neither. You can change this at any time during play as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/1b9a4b2320816067fd8b665f2dffbaaf7c860eb9.gif[/img]
Showing interest in a specific gender will let the corresponding characters be more forward and flirty towards you, and will open up additional dialogue options. Here's an example in action!
If you show interest in women, you have the option to compliment Sylas:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/9102c03e9945f2f264abe5231a0dc333a4445c23.gif[/img]
If you're not interested in women, the game will auto-pick the friendly response instead:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/7e7e96539b232d74019571ace0b53a8167fdb09b.gif[/img]
Even if you're into a specific gender, you always get the option to pick the friendly response instead:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/df19c415eb8cfda17a3ef4c516ef7ae7f400910f.gif[/img]
[h3]What a treat![/h3]
There are six beautiful CGs/illustrations in [i]Shadow Bonds[/i]. Two of them require specific romances: Malec and Sylas. Here's a sneak peek!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/2ecf3e645f3f789dc8b95a6d8b561c23d9bcca7e.png[/img]

[i]Sigh of the Abyss: Shadow Bonds[/i] releases on April 5! Join us next week for more about the game. 
You can also check out the shiny new  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TdRPJRV6CJM]voiced trailer[/url]!

notes.title: Meet the cast!
notes.notes:
Greetings, envoys!
We'll be posting something every week leading up to the release of [i]Shadow Bonds[/i]. 
Today we want to introduce you to the characters that will be your friends, enemies, or perhaps lovers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/fc5c884457822ab5c15259ef35ca741cb6009186.png[/img]
[h3]A side-story as introduction[/h3]
When we set out to develop [i]Shadow Bonds[/i], we wanted it to be an introduction to the characters and setting of [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i], but we also wanted it to be a complete experience. 
Instead of picking the first few hours of the game, we decided to develop a brand new side-story, something self-contained that could be enjoyed on its own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/e09aa6df171008375df19c2f3ff3109d2c5e84af.png[/img]
In [i]Shadow Bonds[/i], the characters you meet already have a relationship with the protagonist—so you skip the guarded 'getting to know each other' phase to experience a bond already formed.
And if you want to bring that bond to the next level, you can! [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] will give you a taste of the romances as well.
[h2]Malec[/h2]
[quote] I don't ask questions when I know I can't handle the answers. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/77130fe93679604404f56e72b44e78a3354858d3.png[/img]
Malec is usually found in the pawn shop he inherited, doodling on the thick layer of dust that covers every cabinet. Torn between the business and his artistic inclinations, he does everything he can to stall making a decision. Sometimes you wonder why.
[h2]Sylas[/h2]
[quote] If it's not too much of a bother, I need to borrow you for a few hours. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/39646b33be02c722e51aa62443a49655a043d152.png[/img]
Not many street urchins make it to adult age—Sylas is one of the lucky few. She is not afraid to get her hands dirty, or lie a bit, or steal here and there... that's how she survived.
But now she's not alone anymore: she found a friend in you.
[h2]Alpheon[/h2]
[quote] Make the tale epic and dramatic, and say that my hair billowing in the wind made me look particularly dashing. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/e084de883e34730aafe8e2aa38fb83d4fb003f72.png[/img]
Alpheon calls himself a great singer, an even better lover and an average lute player, but his true talent lies in his persuasiveness. At times his eyes show purple hues, the shadows shift, and the impossible happens.
[h2]Marané[/h2]
[quote] There is untold power in the dirt we pretend not to see. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/a001827bf9b519a48adc6aa78cba62e4ac415ac2.png[/img]
Her blue robes indicate her allegiance to the Halls of Elevation, the place that some mages call home, others call prison. Having been granted some temporary freedom, Marané is doing everything in her power to make the time count, despite being tightlipped about her true objective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591093/c443e6ed6320097c9d0a5bfb6687351f90002f70.png[/img]

You'll be able to meet these four (and more) soon!
Join us next week for more [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i]. You can also check out the shiny new  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TdRPJRV6CJM]voiced trailer[/url]!
